checks.invariant: A tool/resource call must retain the authenticated request principal and cannot select another connection or identity.

checks.result: lib/mcp/http.ts:132 authenticates before service construction; lib/mcp/server.ts:1816 and :1867 send both JSON and HTML resources through service.getRequirement, whose service-requirements.ts:644 and :706 gates parent/version visibility. import-service.ts:2835 loads sessions by token and caller fingerprint, :2846 reauthorizes inspection, and :2918-2938 reacquires/locks the owned session and reauthorizes execution. checks.invariant: Validation-to-execution and retry must preserve principal, destination, current authorization and one-time row consumption.
checks.result: import-service.ts:1992 uses 32 random bytes for opaque tokens, stores their hash, and :2610 derives the caller fingerprint from verified HSA ID. Fingerprint helpers trim/validate HSA and use domain-separated HMAC (lib/mcp/import-validation-principal.ts:25; import-validation-fingerprint.mjs:22). Execute runs SERIALIZABLE at import-service.ts:2910, locks ownership lookup at :2918, obtains fresh transactional assignment authorization at :2931 via service.ts:613, rejects changed budgets/reference data at :2947 and :2966, and uses stored destination. :3011-3018 excludes persisted imported rows, :3148-3167 bounds and persists receipts in the same transaction. No authority growth, destination substitution or retry re-import path was identified.

checks.invariant: Imported data cannot choose an unauthorized destination, override immutable validation state, or restore stale authority.

checks.invariant: Import quota usage must be bound to verified principal/destination and admitted atomically with accurate storage reservation.

DAL :254-351 serializes admission using a transaction-owned global applock, locked current settings, SQL clock, principal/destination session counts, global reserved-byte sum and per-principal fixed-window creation counter; :411-434 increments that counter in the same transaction. lib/mcp/import-validation-storage.ts:27-64 counts UTF-16 SQL strings and reserves a bounded future receipt, enforced at import-service.ts:3150. import-capacity.ts:14 and :49-54 bound in-flight imports and release in finally. Expired state is ineligible to use and purge batches are bounded at transient-cleanup/requirement-import-validation-sessions.ts:76-100. No caller-controlled quota-key/reset bypass was found.
